description: Flowering occurs in January/February, and fruiting in April/May in northern populations
grading to flowering in May/June and fruiting in January/February in southern populations
Flowers from December to January in northern populations ...; fruiting occurs in March (north)
grading to March in the south; ... grading to October and November (south)
